title: Yummy Rich Thai Tofu Curry
description: A gooey, low calorie Thai curry featuring english mustard and a gentle bain-marie method, perfect for a lazy Sunday meal.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and ginger and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Stir in the red curry paste and english mustard, cooking for 30 seconds to release flavors.
Pour in the light coconut milk and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer, using a bain-marie approach by placing the skillet over a pot of boiling water.
Add the cubed tofu and light soy sauce, then reduce heat to low and let the curry simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in lime juice, adjusting seasoning with additional soy sauce if needed.
Remove the skillet from the water bath and let the curry rest for 2 minutes to thicken slightly.
Serve the curry hot over cooked jasmine rice, if desired.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro leaves on top for a fresh finish.
Enjoy a rich, gooey Thai tofu curry that is low in calories and perfect for lazy Sundays.
